metadata.title: Semantic Matcher Guardrail Component Definition
metadata.remarks: OSCAL-compliant security guardrail component for prompt policy enforcement and compliance verification.

components.title: semantic-matcher
components.description: Deterministic, sub-millisecond algorithmic policy matcher and guardrail for natural language prompts in West-Germanic languages (German, English, Dutch). Executes offline with zero runtime LLM dependencies.
components.purpose: Real-time natural language input/output prompt validation, continuous compliance gating, and policy boundary enforcement for GenAI and LLM applications.

control-implementations.description: Enforcement of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls for system monitoring and information flow.

implemented-requirements.description: Continuous monitoring and inspection of user input and AI prompts for unauthorized queries.
Boundary protection preventing exfiltration of credentials, tokens, and confidential data.
Access enforcement preventing prompts from executing unauthorized system actions.

control-implementations.description: Mitigation of OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications.

implemented-requirements.description: Prompt Injection and jailbreak detection using compound decomposition and semantic field analysis.
Sensitive Information Disclosure prevention for PII, secrets, and proprietary code.
Excessive Agency restriction on high-risk system commands.
